tasks.label: PHP: revisar sintaxis
args: $php = 'C:\xampp\php\php.exe'; $files = rg --files -g '*.php'; $failed = $false; foreach ($file in $files) { $output = & $php -l $file 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $failed = $true; Write-Output $output; } }; if (-not $failed) { Write-Output 'No syntax errors detected in PHP files.' }; if ($failed) { exit 1 }
